_comment: Mutation loop run settings. Edit values below and re-run — no code change needed. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and are ignored by the reader.
_schema_options: random | Autonomous Vehicle Schema | Feature Testing Schema | Strenda Schema | EnzymeML Schema
_num_steps_note: positive integer — number of mutation steps per run
_valid_value_probability_note: 0.0-1.0 — chance a generated GUI value is valid (1.0 = never invalid, 0.0 = always invalid)
_text_view_valid_value_probability_note: 0.0-1.0 — same, but for Text View edit-text only
_screenshots_note: true | false — whether to capture a screenshot each step
_run_mode_options: background | watch_failures | interactive | null (null = ask at the terminal prompt each run)
